failures: Leakage: at least 6 kept extra_train rows are copies of field_dev/field_test photos (same stock photo with a watermark, crop or caption difference), contradicting the plan's 'no field_dev or field_test photo or copy reaches training' and the docs claim. Pairs (extra | field photo, split): (1) datasets/raw/plantwild/plantwild/images/strawberry leaf/google_0526.jpg | datasets/raw/plantdoc/Strawberry leaf/stock-photo-strawberry-leaf-isolated-on-white-background-572055775.jpg, field_test; (2) .../soybean leaf/google_0562.jpg | datasets/raw/plantdoc/Soyabean leaf/26e963a3c2ee.jpg, field_test; (3) .../blueberry leaf/169.jpg | datasets/raw/plantdoc/Blueberry leaf/leaf-blueberry-15281271.jpg, field_dev; (4) .../raspberry leaf/61.jpg | datasets/raw/plantdoc/Raspberry leaf/raspberry-leaf-isolated-white-18415125.jpg, field_dev; (5) .../strawberry leaf/google_0201.jpg | datasets/raw/plantdoc/Strawberry leaf/a345f610f268.jpg, field_test; (6) .../raspberry leaf/google_0075.jpg | datasets/raw/plantdoc/Raspberry leaf/raspberry-leaves-isolated-28028038.jpg, field_test. Reproduce: 32x32 grayscale, mean-centred correlation, max over 4 rotations and horizontal flip, extras vs field_dev/test; view the top 15 pairs. These are all in the healthy or thin classes the doc says it helps, and the build's 0.75 guard and 0.88 rule missed them (watermarks lower the masked score). The implementer viewed 3 of 60 close pairs, and the docs concede unviewed copies may remain, but the plan item is not met and the real-manifest test checks only exact sha1.

The leak means E12 (T4.6) dev scores on field_dev would be inflated for classes such as Strawberry healthy, Raspberry healthy, Blueberry healthy and Soybean healthy. Fix: remove these rows and review the remaining hash-close or correlation-close pairs (hundreds above 0.8; I viewed only the top 27), or add a reviewed-copies list with a test that the list is applied.
notes: Numbers in docs/extra-sources.md (kept counts, per-class table) are correct as recomputed from the manifest; the removal-step counts were not independently rerun. The 'Added per class' table and 'thin classes helped' claims stand as counts, but the healthy-class additions include copies of dev/test photos. PlantWild images in the sampled classes are noisy (whole plants, fruit, cobs, fields), which may weaken training value; E12 will show that. Per the coordinator, tests were run through the queue script and image hashing was kept to one pass at a time.
